note: Both sets pad their output by misreading the legend callouts (circled 3 = Sunpreme GX290 module, circled 11 = #10G bonding jumper) as numeric 'values', 'quantities' or connection targets, but Set B does this more often and adds clear misbindings: it attributes the U.V. rating to the current-carrying cable (note 2 assigns it to cable ties), invents SA3-2/SA3-3 connections to the mounting rails, and calls the 11 callout an 'interconnecting component value'. Set A is more faithful on the notes and legend (USE-2 10 G.A. cable spec with its 'all current carrying cable' condition, frameless glass design) and keeps a consistent, supported series polarity pattern (- to +) across the strings, with only two invented polarities (SA2-25 to WEATHERHEAD, SA2-26 to SA2-27). Set B does capture two facts A misses (NEMA 3R junction box on side of house, SUNPREME GX290 model) plus the planter-equipment feed, but it carries more wrong and unsupported claims overall.
